Enum Class Feature

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Feature>
be.imgn.gaia.memfs.Feature
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Feature>, Constable
public enum Feature extends Enum<Feature>
An optional capability of a file system. An operation that needs a capability the file system lacks throws UnsupportedOperationException.

0.1.1

      public static final Feature FILE_CHANNEL
